existing_group_assignments.rationale: Lipid peroxidation is the same process as 'Increase, Lipid peroxidation' and the membrane-lipid oxidation event, differing only in specificity.
Persistent/sustained proliferation matches 'Induction, Sustained Cell Proliferation' in the existing group.
Liver cancer is a liver tumor endpoint, related to the hepatocellular carcinoma and liver tumor events with differing specificity.
Increased follicular atresia is an increase in loss of the follicle/oocyte pool, like increased oocyte atresia, with differing specificity.
Decreased locomotor activity is the same endpoint as 'Decreased, locomotion', in the opposite direction to 'Increased, locomotion'.
Protein adduct formation concerns the same protein object as alkylation and covalent binding, but is described differently.
